description: Traffic, errors and latency of the contratopublico backend API, and the base.gov scraper.

panels.title: Backend
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the backend's metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Requests / min
panels.description: Current request rate across the selected routes.

panels.title: Requests in range
panels.description: Total requests in the selected time range.

panels.title: 5xx error rate
panels.description: Share of requests that returned a 5xx status in the selected time range.

panels.title: Rate limited
panels.description: Share of requests rejected by the rate limiter in the selected time range.

panels.title: Latency in range
panels.description: Request latency percentiles over the whole selected time range.

panels.title: Per-endpoint summary
panels.description: Traffic, errors and latency per route over the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (path) (increase(http_requests_total{path=~"$path",status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (path) (increase(http_requests_total{path=~"$path"}[$__range]))) / sum by (path) (increase(http_requests_total{path=~"$path"}[$__range]))

(sum by (path) (increase(http_requests_total{path=~"$path",status=~"429"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (path) (increase(http_requests_total{path=~"$path"}[$__range]))) / sum by (path) (increase(http_requests_total{path=~"$path"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Overall request latency. Gaps mean there were no requests in that window.

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: How many requests fell into each latency bucket over time. Brighter means more requests.

panels.title: 5xx error rate by route
panels.description: Share of each route's requests that returned a 5xx status.

targets.expr: (sum by (path) (rate(http_requests_total{path=~"$path",status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (path) (rate(http_requests_total{path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (path) (rate(http_requests_total{path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Non-2xx responses / min
panels.description: Every response that wasn't a success, by status and route.

panels.title: Scraper
panels.description: Whether a scrape of base.gov is running right now. No data means the scraper is disabled.

panels.title: Last successful scrape
panels.description: Time since the last scrape that went through every page. A new scrape starts an hour after the previous one ends, so this should stay under ~2h. Resets on backend restart.

panels.title: Next scrape
panels.description: Time until the next scrape starts. Shows "Running now" while a scrape is in progress.

panels.title: Contracts saved
panels.description: New contracts scraped and saved in the selected time range.

panels.title: base.gov errors
panels.description: Share of requests to base.gov that failed in the selected time range (network errors, timeouts or unexpected responses).

panels.title: Page progress
panels.description: Page of base.gov results the scraper is on, out of the total number of pages.

panels.title: Contracts scraped
panels.description: Contracts saved, and contracts that were given up on after retries (fetch) or couldn't be stored (save).

panels.title: base.gov requests / min
panels.description: Successful requests by type (search result pages and contract details), and failed requests.

panels.title: base.gov latency
panels.description: How long base.gov takes to answer, by request type. Solid is p95, dashed is p50.

panels.title: Page progress
panels.description: Page of base.gov results the scraper is on, against the total number of pages.
